source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 308 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 308.

PD 308.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 308 was established by Ordinance No. 20280, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 26, 1989. Ordinance No. 20280 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 20280 was amended by Ordinance No. 23852, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 14, 1999. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 20280; 23852; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 308 is established on property generally located at the northeast, southeast, and southwest corners of Forest Lane and Webb Chapel Road. The size of PD 308 is approximately 43.405 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and provisions contained in Chapter 51A apply to this article. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: Conceptual Site Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.104. CONCEPTUAL SITE PLAN.

Development of the Property must conform with the conceptual site plan (Exhibit 308A). (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) Except as provided in Subsection (b) below, a development plan for each phase of development must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of any building permit for that phase. Each development plan must include the site plan requisites listed in Section 51A-4.803(d). All development on the Property must comply with the approved development plans.

(b) On Tract B, no detailed development plan is required if the building permit is limited to the remodeling of structures in existence on April 26, 1989. (Ord. Nos. 23852; 25850)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.106. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

(a) A landscape plan must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission at the same time as each development plan.

(b) Prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for an office use in a structure in existence on April 26, 1989 on Tract B, landscaping must be provided as follows:

(1) Six hundred caliper inches of large canopy trees, 45 caliper inches of large non- canopy trees, and 120 inches of small trees must be planted on Tract B.

(2) Evergreen shrubs, trees, and other landscape materials must be planted along Forest Lane as shown on the planting plan (Exhibit 308B).

(c) All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 23852; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.107. USES.

(a) Tract B. The only uses allowed on Tract B are those permitted in the MU-1 Mixed Use District.

(b) Tracts C and D. The only uses allowed on Tracts C and D are those permitted in the CR Community Retail District. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Development
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.108. MAXIMUM DEVELOPMENT.

(a) Maximum floor areas on Tract B.

(1) Maximum floor area permitted on Tract B is 2,667,500 square feet.

(2) Maximum floor areas permitted in each subarea of Tract B are as follows:

Maximum floor area Subarea (in square feet)__

Tract B1 1,757,000 Tract B2 1,000,000 Tract B3 150,000

(3) Maximum floor areas for nonresidential uses permitted on Tract B are as follows:

Maximum floor area Use category (in square feet)__

Office 2,677,500 Retail 100,000 *Hotel 300,000 (of guest rooms)

*Maximum number of hotel guest rooms permitted on Tract B is 300.

(4) Maximum number of residential dwelling units permitted on Tract B is 300.

(5) If a mix of uses is provided on Tract B, the total permitted floor area for office uses shall be reduced as follows:

(A) For every 250 square feet of retail floor area that is developed, the permitted office floor area is reduced by 1,000 square feet.

(B) For every hotel room that is developed, the office floor area permitted is reduced by 675 square feet.

(C) For every residential dwelling unit that is developed, the permitted office floor area is reduced by 675 square feet.

(b) Maximum floor area on Tracts C and D. Maximum floor area ratio on Tracts C and D is the same as maximum floor area ratio for the CR Community Retail District. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.109. HEIGHT.

(a) Maximum height on Tract B. Maximum height permitted for any structure is 180 feet.

(b) Maximum height on Tracts C and D. Maximum height permitted for any structure is the maximum height for a structure in the CR Community Retail District.

(c) Residential proximity slope. If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion may not be located above a residential proximity slope. (See Section 51A-4.412.) Exception: Structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project through the slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.110. MAXIMUM LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum lot coverage permitted on the Property including above-grade parking structures is 80 percent. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.111. SETBACKS.

All structures on Tract B must observe the setbacks required for structures in the MU-1 Mixed Use District. All structures on Tracts C and D must observe the setbacks required for structures in the CR Community Retail District. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.112. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. All uses constructed on Tract B shall be considered as having been constructed on the same lot for purposes of calculating the mixed use parking reduction bonus pursuant to Section 51A- 4.301(c)(6). Above-grade parking is prohibited on Tract B3, as shown on the conceptual site plan. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: Reflective Glass Prohibition
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.113. REFLECTIVE GLASS PROHIBITION.

The exterior visible reflectance percentage of glass used for exterior building material must not exceed 27 percent. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: Development Phasing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.114. DEVELOPMENT PHASING.

Development of the Property must be phased to coincide with major transportation improvements. For purposes of this section, the term "office floor area" includes floor area for office, retail, hotel, and residential uses. In order to calculate the floor area for phasing purposes, each 250 square feet of retail floor area is equivalent to 1,000 square feet of office floor area, and each hotel guest room or residential dwelling unit is equivalent to 675 square feet of office floor area. All improvements must be designed and completed to the specifications of the director of public works and transportation and, where applicable, the State Department of Highways and Public Transportation. Development will be phased as follows:

(1) Phase 1. No building permit may be issued to authorize more than 525,000 square feet of office floor area on Tract B until the improvements listed for Phase 1 in Table 1 have been completed.

(2) Phase 2. No building permit may be issued to authorize more than 993,700 square feet of office floor area on Tract B until the improvements listed for Phase 2 in Table 1 have been completed.

(3) Phase 3. No building permit may be issued to authorize more than 1,578,700 square feet of office floor area on Tract B until the improvements listed for Phase 3 in Table 1 have been completed.

(4) Phase 4. Upon completion of a minimum four lane road from Bankway Lane to Webb Chapel Road with geometric standards equivalent to a secondary street as approved by the director of public works and transportation, an additional 708,400 square feet of office floor area may be developed on Tract B. The development of the additional 708,400 square feet of office floor area may occur in conjunction with Phase 2 or 3.

(6) Right turn lane - e/b LBJ service road to s/b Webb Chapel Road.

(7) Left turn lane - w/b LBJ service road to s/b Webb Chapel Road.

(8) Right turn lane - e/b Forest Lane to s/b Webb Chapel Road.

(9) U-turn lane - e/b to w/b at LBJ and Webb Chapel Road.

(10) Webb Chapel - (under LBJ bridge) reconstructed to eight lanes; and reconstruction of north and south approaches of LBJ.

(11) Josey Lane - (under the LBJ bridge) reconstructed to six lanes; and reconstruction of north and south approaches of LBJ.

(12) Right turn lane - e/b LBJ service road to s/b Josey Lane.

(13) Left turn lane - w/b LBJ service road to s/b Josey Lane.

References to "LBJ" mean Interstate Highway 635, known as Lyndon Baines Johnson Freeway. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 23852; 25850)

sections.title: Access To The Property
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.115. ACCESS TO THE PROPERTY.

Access to the Property from High Brook Drive must be prohibited within 120 days of April 26, 1989. Access to Tract B from Forest Lane east of Webb Chapel Road is limited to two median openings. Access to Tract B from Webb Chapel Road between Forest Lane and LBJ Freeway is limited to one median opening. The location and design of all medians must be approved by the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.116. PAVING.

All streets, driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering areas for parking must comply with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.117. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII, “Sign Regulations,” except that non-premise signs are prohibited. For purposes of this section, the entire PD shall be considered the premise. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.118. LIGHTING.

No lighting fixture which is located on or off buildings on the Property may be mounted at a height greater than 20 feet above grade, or a height which penetrates the residential proximity slope, whichever is greater. Lighting must average, on a maintained basis, an intensity of between 0.1 and 0.5 footcandle at ground level measured at the boundary line of the Property. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.119. SCREENING.

An eight-foot-high masonry screening wall must be provided along the entire east property line of Tract B, and the entire south property lines of Tracts C and D, as shown on the conceptual site plan. The masonry screening wall located on each tract must be completed prior to the issuance of any building permit for a new structure on that tract. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.120. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with the requirements of all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-308.121. ZONING MAP.

PD 308 is located on Zoning Map No. D-5. (Ord. Nos. 20280; 25850)
